en.hubeali:
Ali Bin IBrahi, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Asama Zayd Al Shaham, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> paused at Mina where he<sup>saww</sup> fulfilled his<sup>saww</sup> rituals during the Farewell Hajj.

So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘O you people! Listen to what I<sup>saww</sup> am saying to you all, and understand from me<sup>saww</sup>, for I<sup>saww</sup> do not know, perhaps I<sup>saww</sup> would not meet you all again during this year of ours’.

Then he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Which day is greatest in sanctity?’ They said, ‘This day!’. He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘So which month is greatest in sanctity?’ They said, ‘This month!’ He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘So which city is greatest in sanctity?’ They said, ‘This city!’

He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘So your blood, and your wealth are sacred upon you like the sacredness of this day of yours, in this month of yours, in this city of yours, up to the day you meet Him<sup>azwj</sup>, so He<sup>azwj</sup> would be Questioning you about your deeds.
Indeed!
Have I<sup>saww</sup> delivered (the Message)?’ They said: ‘Yes!’

He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Be Witness! The one with whom is an entrustment, so let him pay it to the one who had entrusted it upon him, for the blood of a Muslim person and his wealth are not Permissible except if he himself agrees to it; and do not do injustice to yourselves (commit sins), and do not return to Infidelity after me<sup>saww</sup>!’
